data.name: Victarion
data.gender_notes: Victarion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'victor', which means conqueror or victor. In Christian tradition, the name represents the triumph and victory over sin and death through faith in Jesus Christ. The name Victarion carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Victarion usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the victory that comes from God through faith and perseverance.
data.etymology: Victarion belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Victarion total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: וצריון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: וצריון, שם נבואי, מבוסס על המושג 'ניצחון'. הרעיון של ניצחון חשוב מאוד ביהדות ובנצרות, ולעיתים קרובות מסמל ניצחון במלחמה, אבל גם ניצחון על רשע, על עצמנו, על התיאבון, וכדומה.

in_greek.name: Βικταρίων
in_greek.long_meaning: Βικταρίων, προφητικός όνομα, βασίζεται στην ιδέα της νίκης. Η ιδέα της νίκης είναι πολύ σημαντική στην Ιουδαιο-Χριστιανική παράδοση, και συχνά συμβολίζει νίκη σε πόλεμο, αλλά επίσης νίκη επί του κακοήθους, επί της ourselves, επί της αμαρτίας, και κτλ.

in_latin.name: Victarion
in_latin.long_meaning: Victarion, nomen prophetica, aeterna victoriae conceptu inspiratur. Aeterna victoria in Iudaico-Christianae traditionis magni momenti est, et saepe bellum, sed etiam malum, malum in seipsis, malum in peccato, et similia vincere significat.

in_english.name: Victarion
in_english.long_meaning: Victarion, a prophetic name, is based on the concept of eternal victory. Eternal victory is of great significance in the Judeo-Christian tradition, and often symbolizes victory in war, but also victory over evil, victory over oneself, victory over sin, and so on. As a given name, Victarion is considered strong and courageous, suitable for a child who is destined for great things.

pronunciation.biblical: In biblical Hebrew, the pronunciation would be closer to 'viktah-ree-on'.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Victarion' carries a strong sense of power and dominance. Historical Christian figures with similar names such as Victor Emmanuel II, Victor Hugo, and Victor Almonte were known for their leadership and achievements. The name can inspire a sense of courage and confidence in its bearer.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name 'Victarion' represents the ultimate conquest and victory in life - salvation through faith in Jesus Christ. It serves as a reminder that no matter what challenges or hardships one may face, they can overcome them through their faith and the power of God. The name calls us to trust in the Lord, for He is our victor and our savior.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Victarion, meaning "Victor Lion," embodies the strength and courage of a lion in the face of adversity. This name carries the spirit of Christian victory, representing the triumph of the lion of Judah over sin and the world.

biblical_reference.note: The name Victarion does not have a direct biblical reference, but the concept of victory is present throughout the Bible.

historical_references.reference: Victarion is believed to have been named after the Roman god Victory. The name was popular among the ancient Romans and was often given to soldiers who achieved great victories in battle.
historical_references.time_period: Roman Empire (1st century BC - 5th century AD)

historical_references.reference: In the fictional universe of George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series, Victarion Greyjoy is a prominent character who is the younger brother of Balon Greyjoy, Lord of the Iron Islands. He takes the name Victarion as a reminder of his past victories and as a symbol of his desire for conquest and victory.
historical_references.time_period: Fantasy (A Song of Ice and Fire series, published since 1991)

trends: A Song of Ice and Fire (book series)
modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Victarion' is most notably known from George R.R. Martin's 'A Song of Ice and Fire' book series and the subsequent HBO 'Game of Thrones' TV show. In both, Victarion is a prominent character in the Dothraki culture, serving as both a warlord and a member of Daenerys Targaryen's inner circle. His name has also gained popularity in the tabletop role-playing game adaptations of the series, allowing players to assume the role of this complex and formidable character in their own campaigns.

name_in_real_life.story: Thomas Victarion, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Victarion meaning "Conqueror, Victor" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
